modules.name: tb_synth_system
modules.description: Real UART and ADC pins through boot, arbitration, AXI command execution, voice/LFO/FX and independent PT8211 decoder.

reset.name: i_axis_arstn
reset.values: all pipeline valid and output data/tag registers clear; external synchronous release

behavior: Real UART and ADC pins through boot, arbitration, AXI command execution, voice/LFO/FX and independent PT8211 decoder.
完整实体键/UART/四音色/PCM/PT8211回归，满载计算必须观测到948拍，且每帧严格小于1024拍。
默认干声构建：57启动命令，FX命令状态1，能力/容量/遥测为0；保留PCM队列及PT8211频率。
constraints: Verilog-2001, single50MHz clock; asynchronous reset assertion, externally synchronized release.
See SYSTEM.md and model/system_model.py for ABI, numerical behavior, memory images and validation scope.
corner_cases: changing tags and parameters every accepted beat
verification_cases: Real UART/ADC pins to serial DAC simulation
AXI stalls, transaction ownership, duplicate/conflicting/invalid requests and reset
Boot, physical chord, release, host voice/FX commands and resource/timing checks
实测66按键事件、134串口回复，CRC缓存重放、4预设、8声部、PT8211逐帧解码及零drop/overrun/underrun；PCM脉冲最大878拍、native压力835拍。
